text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... What is this UmaTube video? 
Footage of a Western mansion... Huh, that 
red light is... eyes? Ah, eek!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...So it was a movie preview... *sigh* I 
wonder if it's going to play again...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh... No, Eye! You'll never win if all you 
do is get intimidated!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...All right, let's just go see it 
properly! No running away, head-on with 
everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The Umart preview from earlier was... 
There it is! "The Most Terrifying Curse: 
120 Minutes of Terror"...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...T-The absolute scariest...! I-It's 
okay! I'll be fine... ...Definitely!
